dedupe_keys.name: high resolution air pollution emission inventory for the nordic countries

description: The NordicWelfAir collaboration publishes a harmonised air-pollution emissions inventory for Denmark, Finland, Iceland, Norway and Sweden. Selected annual totals span 1990–2014 for particulate matter, black and organic carbon, sulphur and nitrogen oxides, carbon monoxide, volatile organic compounds and ammonia. National inventories were harmonised to SNAP sectors on a 1 km ETRS89-LAEA grid. NetCDF grids and an Excel point-source table include large-source locations and stack heights. Zenodo provides open, free access under CC-BY-4.0. The inventory adjusts road non-exhaust particle emissions and estimates organic carbon using expert ratios. These choices and national differences in spatial allocation create uncertainty. The data could drive dispersion simulations comparing transport or energy scenarios and related health exposure. It complements national emissions totals with spatial allocation and point-source details. Its previous water-only screening rejection does not address these uses.
